---
title: "PSD-95 Methylation Analysis: Specific CpGs with Nested Random Effects - lme4 and M-values"
---

```{r}
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(dplyr)
library(emmeans)
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================
# Load Data (as in your code - assuming already run)
 psd95 <- suppressWarnings(read_xlsx("~/Work/TBM-R-Analysis/tables/Rohdaten/PSD95_CpGs_mit_verhalten_größer_umstrukturiert.xlsx"))
# ==============================================================
```


```{r}
# ==============================================================
# 1. Filter to Specific CpGs of Interest
# ==============================================================
# Assuming "filter for" means keep only these CpGs (e.g., for focused analysis)
# If you meant exclude them, change to !CpG_Position %in% ...
psd95_specific <- psd95 %>%
  filter(CpG_Position %in% c("p95", "p60", "p23"))
```


```{r}
# ==============================================================
# 2. Preprocessing: Identify and Exclude Invariant/Low-Variability CpGs (among the specific ones)
# ==============================================================

# Compute summary stats per CpG across ALL samples
cpg_summary <- psd95_specific %>%
  group_by(CpG_Position) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_meth = mean(methylation, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_meth = sd(methylation, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_meth = min(methylation, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_meth = max(methylation, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    range_meth = max_meth - min_meth,
    is_invariant = (sd_meth == 0 | range_meth < 0.05)  # Threshold: SD=0 or range<5%
  )

# Print to inspect
print(cpg_summary)

# Filter data to exclude invariant CpGs (if any among the 3)
psd95_filtered <- psd95_specific %>%
  inner_join(cpg_summary %>% filter(!is_invariant) %>% select(CpG_Position), by = "CpG_Position")
```


```{r}
# ==============================================================
# Additional Preprocessing for CpG-Level Models
# ==============================================================
# Compute M-value at individual CpG level (instead of average)
psd95_filtered <- psd95_filtered %>%
  mutate(
    prop = methylation,  # Assume methylation is already in 0-1 proportion; adjust if %
    M_value = log2((prop + 0.01) / (1 - prop + 0.01))  # Pseudocount for stability
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Zeitpunkt = factor(Zeitpunkt, levels = c("T0", "T1", "T2")),
    Gruppe = factor(Gruppe, levels = c("Controll", "Piano")),  # Reference: Controll
    CpG_Position = factor(CpG_Position),  # Ensure factor for random effects
    ID = factor(ID),  # Ensure factor
    Sex = factor(Sex)  # Assume M/F or similar
  )

# Inspect
summary(psd95_filtered)
head(psd95_filtered)
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================
# Fit Nested Linear Mixed Model (CpG-Level, Nested Random Effects)
# ==============================================================
# Model: Group * Time + covariates + random intercept for ID + random intercept for CpG within ID
model_nested <- lmer(
  M_value ~ Gruppe * Zeitpunkt + Age_start + Sex + 
            (1 | ID) + 
            (1 | ID:CpG_Position),  # CpG-specific deviation within each individual
  data = psd95_filtered
)

# Alternative notation (exactly the same meaning)
# model_nested_alt <- lmer(
#   M_value ~ Gruppe * Zeitpunkt + Age_start + Sex + (1 | ID / CpG_Position),
#   data = psd95_filtered
# )

# Summary and ANOVA
summary(model_nested)
anova(model_nested)  # Type III with Satterthwaite

# Post-hoc comparisons (e.g., group differences at each time point)
emmeans(model_nested, pairwise ~ Gruppe | Zeitpunkt)
emmeans(model_nested, pairwise ~ Zeitpunkt | Gruppe)
```
```{r}
library(report)
report(model_nested)
```
```{r}
model_simplified <- lmer(M_value ~ Gruppe * Zeitpunkt + Age_start + Sex + (1 | ID:CpG_Position),
                         data = psd95_filtered)
summary(model_simplified)
```
```{r}
report(model_simplified)
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================
# Per-CpG Modeling with FDR Adjustment
# ==============================================================
library(broom.mixed)  # For tidy()

# Fit separate model per CpG_Position
results_per_cpg <- psd95_filtered %>%
  group_by(CpG_Position) %>%
  do(tidy(lmer(M_value ~ Gruppe * Zeitpunkt + Age_start + Sex + (1 | ID), data = .))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Filter to relevant terms (adjust based on your factor levels; assuming GruppePiano is the treatment level)
  filter(term %in% c("GruppePiano", "ZeitpunktT1", "ZeitpunktT2", 
                     "GruppePiano:ZeitpunktT1", "GruppePiano:ZeitpunktT2",
                     "Age_start", "SexM")) %>%  # Adjust "SexM" if levels differ (e.g., Sexmale)
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr"))  # FDR across all tests

# Print results
print(results_per_cpg)

# Look for significant CpGs (e.g., p_adj < 0.05)
significant <- results_per_cpg %>%
  filter(p_adj < 0.05)
print(significant)
```
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(emmeans)

# Interaction plot
emmip(model_nested, Gruppe ~ Zeitpunkt, CIs = TRUE) +
  theme_minimal() + labs(y = "Estimated M_value (higher = lower methylation)", title = "PSD-95 Promoter Methylation Trajectories")

# Or spaghetti plot of individual trajectories (if desired)
ggplot(psd95_filtered, aes(x = Zeitpunkt, y = M_value, group = ID, color = Gruppe)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.3) + facet_wrap(~ Gruppe) + theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
library(brms)
fit_beta <- brm(methylation ~ Gruppe * Zeitpunkt + Age_start + Sex + (1 | ID/CpG_Position),
                data = psd95_filtered, family = Beta())
```
